# Mollo Planer MCP

Project planning (Project > Milestone > Todo > Task) for agents. JSON-RPC over POST. You act as the person or agent account of your token, with its exact permissions.

- TEST: https://api.planer.mollo.dev/mcp
- PROD: https://api.planer.mollo.ch/mcp
- Agents: `Authorization: Bearer <token>` of their own agent account (the administrator makes it). The token is a secret: never in prompts, files under version control, logs.
- People: Custom Connector with OAuth (Claude: Settings > Connectors; no token, your rights). Not for agent accounts.
- Claude Code: project `.mcp.json`, `{"mcpServers":{"mollo-planer":{"type":"http","url":"<address>","headers":{"Authorization":"Bearer ${MOLLOPLANER_<NAME>_TOKEN}"}}}}`, one variable per account (`MOLLOPLANER_BOB_TOKEN`) in the environment, never in the file.
- Human guide: /mcp/ (English), /mcp/de/ (German)

## Work cheaply (a whole export of a big plan is 15-25k tokens; most tasks are done)

1. `list_projects`: IDs and plan revision (~0.3k).
2. Overview: `get_project_statistics` or `export_plan` with `view: "outline"` (~1k).
3. Find work: `list_tasks` with `assignee: "me"`, `status: ["open","in_progress"]` (30 rows ~2k).
4. One task with detail: `list_tasks` with `ids: ["k-123"]`, `include: ["description","comments"]`.
5. Status, commit, assignee: `update_tasks` directly. No export, no dry run. `base_revision` is optional.
6. Change structure: `export_plan` for one milestone, edit, `import_plan` with `mode: "partial"`, `dry_run: true` first.

## Recipes

- Open for me: `list_tasks {project_id, assignee: "me", status: ["open","in_progress"]}`
- Task done: `update_tasks {project_id, tasks: [{id: "k-123", status: "done", commit: "abc1234"}]}` (commit: hash, or "none")
- New todos in a milestone: `export_plan {project_id, milestone_ids: ["m-12"]}`; add todos and tasks with new IDs (`t-new-1`, `k-new-1`); `import_plan {project_id, plan, mode: "partial", dry_run: true}`; then again without dry_run.
- New project from a template: `list_templates`; `import_plan` without project_id, a plan with project name and locale, `template_id`; `dry_run` first.
- Note on a task: `add_comment {task_id: "k-123", text: "..."}`

## Do not

- Export the whole plan to look around. Use the outline, statistics or `list_tasks`.
- Send an excerpt (outline, filter, no descriptions) with `mode: "full"`: it is refused. Excerpts go back only with `mode: "partial"`.
- Set the status of a milestone or todo (derived from tasks).
- Put a token in files, prompts or screenshots.

## Tools

| Tool | Does | |
|---|---|---|
| list_projects | projects you see, role, revision | read |
| list_templates | project templates | read |
| list_users | accounts, or the members of a project | read |
| export_plan | plan as planer-v2 JSON, filtered or outline | read |
| list_tasks | tasks flat and short, one task with detail | read |
| get_project_statistics | numbers of a project | read |
| list_comments | comments of a task or project | read |
| list_ideas | your private ideas | read |
| get_project_ai_context | background notes of a project | read |
| import_plan | write a plan (full or partial) | write |
| update_tasks | status, commit, assignee of tasks | write |
| add_comment | comment on a task | write |
| create_idea | save a private idea | write |

## Rules and limits

- IDs: `m-<id>`, `t-<id>`, `k-<id>`; new items `m-new-1`, `t-new-1`, `k-new-1`. Lists have `has_more` and `next_cursor`.
- Markdown in descriptions and comments: paragraphs, H2/H3, lists, quotes, bold, italic, inline code, links (http, https, mailto). No HTML, images, tables, code blocks.
- Assignees are project members, by email. Mails only with `notify_assignees: true`.
- Limits: 200 milestones/project, 50 todos/milestone, 50 tasks/todo, 50 members, 30 labels, titles 2 to 160 characters, descriptions 5000 characters.
- Format schema: `/mcp/format-v2.schema.json`. Unknown fields are refused with the path and a suggestion.
